note: closed-loop 2-1-1 fit; D_y from powered horizontal force (thrust-independent); weathervane+damping from joint kappa/theta_M fit on measured tau_motor | wv_z (sideslip->yaw weathervane) identified by the dedicated yaw-axis fit = -0.00332 (negative = anti-weathervane/destabilizing in the CL FRD convention, consistent with the tail-first instability).
wv_z_method: dedicated per-axis yaw fit (aero_run_yaw.py / fit_yaw_axis) on 7 gentle amp 0.3-0.5 yaw doublets; intercept absorbs the constant yaw-trim torque; kappa/inertia term negligible. Supersedes the joint-fit wv_z (~0, washed out by kappa/damping collinearity).
wv_z_caveat: sign + significance robust; ABSOLUTE magnitude is conditional on the uncalibrated yaw-torque coeff k_q (seeded at 2% of k_f). In-sample R2=0.32, held-out de-meaned R2=0.18 (predicts unseen sideslip-driven yaw effort).
